What it does

Why it beats a clip-on headset

Auto wear detect

It knows when you put it on and pairs with the scooter by itself. Nothing to press.

Calls and music

Answer, reject and skip from the handlebar. Built-in microphone, so people can actually hear you.

Alerts that matter

Navigation prompts, Pothole+ warnings and tow-away zone alerts, spoken rather than glanced at.

USB-C charging

The current generation charges over USB-C — the same cable as everything else you own.
